title: Lekalo Target Protocol
description: Closed wire contract for the lekalo.target/v1 process protocol that connects the Lekalo core to external target adapters running as separate executables in any language; one request on stdin or a bounded temporary file, one response envelope on stdout, diagnostics and logs on stderr only, with version and capability negotiation over the describe handshake, deterministic request identifiers, declared output plans verified against observed writes, and the infrastructure/protocol/operation error classification. Version 0.3.1 additively extended the describe response capabilities with declared IR contract versions, named capability support states, and optional declared constraints; extended scan entries with the closed typed evidence member; and extended request envelopes with the resolved profile digest and capability snapshot. Version 0.3.2 adds one read-only operation plan-native: its request alone carries the required native_request member (bounded changed files/symbols, scan evidence and input custody, observed and execution-policy references, tool catalog and capability snapshot digests), and its successful result alone carries the required native_plan member — the proposed immutable native gate plan the adapter planner proposes without reading or executing anything; the member is forbidden on every other operation, dry_run, plan_id and writes stay forbidden on plan-native, and the frozen 0.3.1 documents keep their exact published meanings. Successor 0.6.4 adds lint, lint_request and lint_evidence. This read-only static collector never executes application code or native gates.
